# /etc/systemd/system/h713-hdmi-video.service
[Unit]
Description=H713 HDMI input on the panel
# Started by the udev rule when the bridge's device becomes ready (signal
# locked or holding); stopped when it becomes not-ready or the bridge goes.
BindsTo=dev-h713\x2dhdmi\x2din.device h713-hdmi-ring.service
After=dev-h713\x2dhdmi\x2din.device h713-hdmi-ring.service
Before=shutdown.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=60
StartLimitBurst=3

[Service]
Type=simple
# Route B (design 10.25.6): NV12 from the bridge as dmabufs straight onto
# the KMS video plane; the console returns when kmssink closes its DRM fd.
# No size or rate in the caps: v4l2src takes them from the DV timings.
ExecStart=/usr/bin/gst-launch-1.0 -e -q v4l2src device=/dev/h713-hdmi-in io-mode=dmabuf ! video/x-raw,format=NV12 ! kmssink driver-name=sun50i-h713-afbd sync=false skip-vsync=true
KillSignal=SIGINT
TimeoutStopSec=5
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=1
